testimonials.name: Andrew Thurston
testimonials.text: These guys did a great job fixing a leak around my fireplace chimney and some loose shingles. Would definitely call them again.

testimonials.name: Tiffany Garmon
testimonials.text: 100/10 will always recommend Dan! When I saw the completed pressure wash, I literally sighed of enjoyment with how it looks!

testimonials.name: Tim Gerber
testimonials.text: From their professionalism to the quality of work, this company is outstanding! Others in the past have killed my grass and flowers.

testimonials.name: Darlene Mangram
testimonials.text: I had my new roof put on Monday. They did an excellent job. They worked all day nonstop. And they cleaned up all the mess. I am very pleased.

testimonials.name: Madison Leigh
testimonials.text: Infinity Roofing was amazing from start to finish. Super professional, showed up on time, and walked me through everything. My new roof looks so good.

testimonials.name: Ashley Ledford
testimonials.text: Dan was really great! I called regarding a gutter clean and pressure wash for my house, driveway, and back patio and he was able to come out the next day to quote.

testimonials.name: BreakOut Bob
testimonials.text: Dan gave us an excellent initial consultation when we needed to replace our roof. He explained the process and gave us several different options.

testimonials.name: Andrew Clark
testimonials.text: Dan put a new shingle roof on my house. He was very professional, friendly, and his crew got it done very quickly. He gave me a great price.

testimonials.name: Matthew Herbert
testimonials.text: By far the best in service, consultation and product. If I was able to leave more stars I would! I have referred them to at least 9 others.

testimonials.name: Jessee Scott
testimonials.text: Dan did an amazing job on my roof. Always on time and communicative. I highly recommend this roofing company.

testimonials.name: Jordan Scragg
testimonials.text: Just had roof redone, replaced all wood and reshingled. Tremendous job, would recommend. Very knowledgeable and professional. After the job, complete clean up.

testimonials.name: James Scott
testimonials.text: Got a few other estimates, but Dan was the most professional and the only one to show up on time.

testimonials.name: Patrick Jones
testimonials.text: Got my roof done very fast and they did everything that was promised. Couldn't ask for more in getting a new roof. Highly recommend.

testimonials.name: Jacob Murphy
testimonials.text: Very clean and thorough job, was very happy with the end result. Any questions or concerns I had were answered and taken care of.

testimonials.name: Tomily Bourgoing
testimonials.text: Quality work and reliable. Dan with Infinity Roofing really took care of us with utmost professionalism. Highly recommend them for any of your roofing needs.

Based in Dallas, GA, we've been protecting homes with honest work, fair pricing, and results that last. We specialize in insurance restoration roofing and handle all communication with your insurance company, from the initial inspection to the final settlement.
